title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, templates, and docs site updates
author: Asha Raman
description:
Motivation: shipping a set of developer-friendly quickstarts and reusable RAG agent templates that demonstrate tool-calling patterns and best-practices for Redwood users. This PR adds opinionated agent templates, three quickstart walkthroughs (redwood-examples), and corresponding docs site pages and example code snippets so users can get started with RAG + tool-calling in under 10 minutes.

What changed (high level):
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates/: three reusable agent templates (faq-bot, ticket-assistant, exec-summary) with tool-integration scaffolding and config examples for model selection, caching, and routing policies.
- redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling/: three step-by-step quickstarts that include Dockerfile, minimal server example, and local test harness.
- redwood-docs/site/content/guides/rag-agent-tool-calling.md: new guide with code snippets, diagrams, and recommended rollout checklist.
- redwood-docs/site/static/snippets/: example prompt sets and test fixtures used by the quickstarts.
- docs navigation and sidebar updates to include the new guide and quickstarts.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add agent templates and config examples
- [x] Add quickstart repos with runnable examples and tests
- [x] Docs site guide + sidebar entry
- [x] Unit tests for example harness (basic smoke)
- [x] Internal cross-reference to Optimize/Console docs for rollout guidance

Commits (summary):
- feat(examples): add rag agent templates and scaffolding (3 templates)
- feat(quickstarts): add rag tool-calling quickstart projects with Docker + tests
- docs: add rag-agent-tool-calling guide and sidebar entry
- test: add smoke tests for each quickstart and CI job
- chore: update docs build pipeline to copy snippet files

Files touched (high level):
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates/faq-bot/template.yaml
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates/ticket-assistant/template.yaml
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates/exec-summary/template.yaml
- redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling/README.md
- redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling/Dockerfile
- redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling/app.py
- redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling/tests/test_smoke.py
- redwood-docs/site/content/guides/rag-agent-tool-calling.md
- redwood-docs/site/static/snippets/rag_prompts.json
- redwood-docs/site/data/sidebar.toml
- .github/workflows/docs-build.yml (small tweak to copy snippets)

Review summary: 
- Tom Nguyen: requested clearer guidance on state management and KV cache expectations for long-running agents; asked to add a short section with recommended cache TTLs and failure modes.
- Author reply: added "KV cache and session management" subsection in the guide and updated templates to include TTL settings (default 1h) and fallback logic.
- Emma Li: requested lint fixes in example Python code and suggested replacing a local in-memory store with the documented redis-backed example for the ticket-assistant quickstart.
- Author reply: swapped example to use a small redis fixture in tests and fixed lint issues.
- Carlos Ruiz: approved with a note to follow-up with a short blog post and internal customer-facing playbook.
- Final review: all reviewers approved; CI green after one rerun.

CI: initial docs build failed due to missing snippet copy step in the build job; fix included in this PR (chore: update docs-build). After pushing the fix and re-running CI, all checks passed (docs build, examples smoke tests, lint).

Merge: squash-merged to main on 2026-02-28 by Emma Li. Release notes: "Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs guide (quickstarts available under redwood-examples)."

Notes for QA and customers: quickstarts are intentionally minimal and documented as production-adjacent examples; they include recommended configuration for Dedicated/Private deployments and explicit callouts for secrets/KMS handling. If you plan to run the quickstarts on Dedicated, pin model versions in the template and follow the rollout checklist in the guide.
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; documentation guide added to docs site; example smoke tests and docs-build fix included.
